wn.name: WaterCraft
wn.numbers: Konke lapha kuyisisekeli sokubala. Unjiniyela wamanzi uhlola yonke imiphumela; izinombolo azisiyo isitifiketi noma idizayini esemthethweni.
wn.privacy: Inethiwekhi yakho ihlala kule projekthi nakule khompyutha. Akukho okuthunyelwa noma kuphi.
wn.stopped: Imisiwe ngaphambi kwesikhathi: uhlu luyilokho okwenziwe kuphela.
wn.err.nonet: Asikho inethiwekhi yamanzi kule projekthi okwamanje. Qala ngokudweba ama-junction, isitoreji namapayipi ngamathuluzi e-Water mains.
wn.err.noloads: Namathisela okungenani umugqa womthwalo owodwa kuqala.
wn.err.trace_node: Khetha isitoreji noma ithange lapho ukulandelela kuqala khona.
wn.err.not_configured: WaterCraft ayikwazanga ukufinyelela isixazululi samanzi. Layisha kabusha ikhasi.
wn.dem.help: Umuntu oyedwa ngomugqa ngamunye: id, x, y, uhlobo, inani. Uhlobo kungaba: {kinds}, noma flow ukuze uthayiphe ukugeleza. Inani liyiyunithi (izindlu), indawo (amaekhari, noma amahektha kumethrikhi) noma ukugeleza. Ngalunye luya kwe-junction eseduze kakhulu.
wn.dem.share: Yabelana ngomthwalo phakathi kwama-junction aseduze, cishe ngo-300 ft (90 m)
wn.dem.starting: Ukusetshenziswa ngendlu noma ngeyekhari kuyisilinganiso sokuqala, hhayi umgomo. Yishintshe ngezibalo zokuklama zenkampani yakho yamanzi ngaphambi kokuthembela emphumeni.
wn.dem.applied: Izidingo zibhalwe kuma-Water mains. Hlehlisa kuzibuyisela emuva.
wn.fire.help: Ngalowo nomvimba womlilo (noma ngama-junction onke uma kungekho olumakiwe): ukugeleza akwazi ukukunikeza uma uxinzelelo lugcina okusele, kutholwe ngesixazululi esifanayo naleso sewindi le-Water mains.
wn.fire.mult: Isilinganiso sesidingo (1 = isidingo njengoba sidwetshiwe; sebenzisa isilinganiso sakho sosuku lokuphakama)
wn.limit.base: uxinzelelo olusezingeni eliphansi ngaphambi kokuthathwa kwanoma yini
wn.crit.help: Ikhipha ipayipi ngalinye ngokulandelanayo iphinde ibale futhi: ukuthi isidingo esingakanani sivinjwa, nokuthi ama-junction awela kuphi ngaphansi koxinzelelo oluncane. Uma kukhona ama-valve abekwe kumapayipi, ungasusa lonke ingxenye enama-valve.
wn.q.help: Ilandela amanzi kuwo wonke umzila wamahora angu-24: ukuthi adala kangakanani, ukuthi kusele ikhlorini elingakanani, noma avela kuphi. Isebenzisa iphethini yesidingo nezinga lamathange e-Water mains.
wn.q.limits: Ukubola kwe-first-order kuphela, ithange liyivolumu eyodwa exubile, akukho masiteshi okukhulisa uxinzelelo okwamanje. Qhuba isikhathi esanele ukuze iphethini iphindeke ngaphambi kokufunda usuku lokugcina.
